derivation: floor(game, property) = 0.8 x the MINIMUM of the three v7 M0 arms' paired_coverage_seed_mean for that cell (never the median: a median flips exactly one of three ACCEPTED v7 arms per cell by construction, measuring rank among v7's own arms rather than sufficiency). min x margin is strictly below the lowest value any v7 arm reached, so it excludes ZERO v7 cells. kuhn exempt, fixed at 1.0.

falsification.anchor: experiment 8's own M0 arms (temperature not yet fixed), never M1/M2 (P1/P4 are M0-only)

history_of_rejected_conditions.condition: majority-or-none (0, 2, or 3 of 3) below a MEDIAN-derived floor
history_of_rejected_conditions.failure: fires on 5 of 8 outcomes under the null (each model ~50% likely to fall below a true median: P(0)+P(2)+P(3) = 1/8+3/8+1/8 = 5/8 = 62.5%) -- a check that cries wolf more often than not

history_of_rejected_conditions.condition: re-derive if the floor moves by more than a stated margin once M1/M2 are scored
history_of_rejected_conditions.failure: can never fire at all: P1/P4 are M0-only, so M1/M2 never produce new P1/P4 coverage numbers to re-derive against

history_of_rejected_conditions.condition: extremes-only (0 of 3, or 3 of 3) below a MEDIAN-derived floor
history_of_rejected_conditions.failure: fired on SUCCESS once the derivation changed to a min-times-margin floor sitting below every accepted v7 arm: under that floor, '0 of 3 below' is the EXPECTED, healthy outcome, not a defect, so this condition would flag a normal result as requiring re-derivation

falsification.trigger: a (game, property) floor is re-derived if a MAJORITY (>= 2 of 3) of experiment 8's models fall below it. A single model below is the floor doing its job (that cell reads inadmissible); a majority means either the floor or experiment 8's coverage structure is wrong.

P1_invariance.reason: kuhn's info-set space is small enough that full coverage is the expected case, not evidence of unusually careful collection; exempt from the median formula and from the re-derivation falsification check, per the darkhex-degeneracy precedent

P4_payoff_sensitivity.reason: kuhn's info-set space is small enough that full coverage is the expected case, not evidence of unusually careful collection; exempt from the median formula and from the re-derivation falsification check, per the darkhex-degeneracy precedent

margin_is_proportional_not_absolute: coverage is a fraction bounded in [0, 1]; an absolute margin would push a low-coverage cell's floor to or below zero and remove the floor precisely where coverage is thinnest. A proportional margin is tightest where coverage is already lowest (e.g. goofspiel P1: min 0.096, floor 0.077, gap 0.019; leduc P1: min 0.396, floor 0.317, gap 0.079) -- the opposite of what an absolute safety margin usually does, but the intended behaviour here, not a flaw: a pilot reaching far fewer shared info-sets than any accepted v7 arm did is exactly the case the floor exists to catch, and that case is most likely on a cell whose own coverage is already thin.
